q: How fast can I book a private jet on EXJET?
a: Standard requests are confirmed in under four hours. Same-day and AOG requests are typically wheels-up in three to six hours depending on your departure city and aircraft availability.

q: What does a private jet cost per hour?
a: Light jets start around $4,500/hr. Midsize jets run $6,000–$8,500/hr. Super midsize $8,500–$11,000/hr. Heavy jets $11,000–$15,000/hr. Ultra-long-range aircraft are $15,000/hr and up. Your quote includes fuel, crew, catering and FBO fees.
Every operator in the EXJET network holds FAA Part 135 certification and is audited to ARGUS Platinum and IS-BAO Stage 3 — the highest independent safety ratings in business aviation.

An empty leg is a repositioning flight — when an aircraft is flying empty to its next booking or back to base. Booking an empty leg can save 50–75% versus a standard charter, with the trade-off that the schedule is fixed.

q: Can I bring pets on board?
a: Yes. Pets fly with you in the cabin on every EXJET flight, no carrier required. Declare pets at booking so we can confirm aircraft suitability and international clearance where applicable.

q: What payment methods do you accept?
a: Wire transfer, ACH, all major credit cards, and Apple/Google Pay for holds up to $100k. Invoices settle at booking confirmation.
